title: Unknown Collation: utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
description: A MySQL 8 dump won't import into MariaDB or MySQL 5.7 because they don't recognise the utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci collation.
causes: Target server has no matching collation name
fixes: Re-export with a compatible default character set
Convert MyISAM tables to InnoDB if 'key too long' follows
